inputs.text: [excited] A long, long time ago, [pauses] even before the dinosaurs, [curious] the Earth looked like one giant puzzle! [amazed] All the continents were stuck together in one huge piece — Africa, America, Europe, all of it! [happily] We call that Pangea.
[curious] Stuck together? All in one piece?

[happily] Exactly! [amazed] You could walk from Africa all the way to America — no boat needed! [excited] One giant continent, like a HUGE raft floating in the ocean. [pauses] And everywhere, it was very, very hot and very, very dry.
